text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyawaa! T-Trainer!? Th-This was just me 
getting caught up in nostalgia, or 
rather...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, I happened to run into Opera 
O-san at the park yesterday..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
To think that I was actually able to watch 
the five-hour special edition of 'Descent 
of the Overlord Opera'~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Remembering that singing voice gives me 
courage. I feel like I can get through 
today without messing up~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you had a very fulfilling day 
off!
